**Sygehus Lillebælt** is a hospital organization in Denmark, operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src4]. In the context of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) annual report for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, Sygehus Lillebælt serves as a combined reporting entity for two specific hospital units: [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]] and [[vejle-sygehus|Vejle Sygehus]] [^src1]. 

According to methodological notes in the AFDK 2023 report, the clinical quality indicator results for Kolding Sygehus and Vejle Sygehus were not correctly distributed between the two individual units in the underlying registry data [^src2]. As a result, the data for these two hospitals must be interpreted collectively as a single entity, Sygehus Lillebælt, across multiple clinical quality indicators [^src3]. This aggregation applies to various indicators detailed in the report, including waiting times for anticoagulation treatment, echocardiography completion, TSH measurements, and long-term treatment coverage [^src1], [^src2], [^src3], [^src4], [^src5]. Consequently, while Sygehus Lillebælt is included in detailed hospital-level analyses, specific numerical data is presented for the combined entity rather than the individual constituent hospitals to ensure statistical accuracy and proper interpretation [^src5].
